# PURE_PLAYER_V1 — held-out results (research only)

* Preregistration: `docs/research/PURE_PLAYER_V1_PREREGISTRATION.md`, committed alone in **dfd7a26**; model code
  frozen at **0441dfc** (`pure-player-v1.0.0`, baseline `pure-ewm-baseline-1.0.0`). No model change after it.
* Dependency audit: `docs/research/PURE_PLAYER_V1_DEPENDENCY_AUDIT.md`.
* Full tables (every pair, scope, season, position group, team layer): `RESULTS_TABLES.md` (generated by
  `scripts/research/pure_player_v1_render.py` from `results.json`).
* Command: `python3 scripts/research/pure_player_v1_study.py --data-root <nflverse root> --seasons 2024,2025,2026
  --last-season 2026 --cache <scratch> --out research/pure_player_v1 --bootstrap 1000 --kit-gate <kit>/scripts/prop_projection_gate.py`

## Verdict (preregistered rule, primary scope 2024+2025, PURE_PLAYER_V1 vs PURE_EWM_BASELINE): **ACCEPTED_CHALLENGER**

ΔMAE < 0 on 9/9 statistics, the game-clustered 95% CI entirely below 0 on 9/9, no statistic significantly worse on
MAE or on the representative-rung Brier. Research collection only; nothing here authorises live use.

It is **not** the most accurate arm in the repository: DATA_PLAYER_V4 (both as-is with `market_env=False` and with
the closing line) is slightly more accurate on most player statistics (below). PURE_PLAYER_V1 is the most
accurate arm whose inputs are football-only AND point-in-time provable from the committed sources.

## Data, population, exclusions

nflverse `stats_player_week`, `snap_counts`, `players` (crosswalk) and the schedule's allowlisted non-market
columns, retrieved 2026-10-10T23:50Z (sha256: `data_manifest.sha256`). Regular season. Training 2014..S-1 for
target season S. Forecast cutoff kickoff − 90 min; every row's latest consumed observation (previous game of the
player / team / opponent + 4 h) is asserted < cutoff (`pipeline.check_point_in_time`).

| season | skill player-games in sports data | played (conditional population) | not played (excluded, all arms) | snap rows forecast / scored (missing snap count) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2024 | 6,699 | 6,476 | 223 | 6,338 / 6,316 |
| 2025 | 6,747 | 6,439 | 308 | 6,309 / 6,251 |
| 2026 wk1-5 (supplementary) | 1,622 | 1,549 | 73 | 1,528 / 1,506 |

Scored rows per statistic (2024 / 2025 / 2026): snap share 6,316 / 6,251 / 1,506; targets, receptions,
receiving yards 5,794 / 5,765 / 1,398; carries, rushing yards 2,023 / 2,005 / 482; passing attempts,
completions, passing yards 544 / 544 / 130 (starting QBs). Games: 272 per primary season. V4 arms are scored on
the subset V4 also forecasts (e.g. 2024 QB rows 513 of 544, carries 1,992 of 2,023 — V4's starter flag comes from
the schedule id joined through its own team normalisation); every V4 comparison is on that matched subset.

By season (ΔMAE, 95% CI): every statistic improves in both 2024 and 2025; CIs exclude 0 except 2024 passing
yards [−2.50, +0.86], 2024 rushing yards [−0.43, +0.08] and 2025 passing attempts [−0.51, +0.02]. 2026 weeks
1-5 (supplementary, fitted on 2014-2025): ΔMAE < 0 on 9/9; CI < 0 for snap share, targets, receptions, receiving
yards, carries; QB statistics and rushing yards inconclusive (130 / 482 rows).

By position group (2024+2025, ΔMAE CI < 0 unless noted): QB attempts / completions / passing yards / snap share
improve; QB carries [−0.069, +0.007] and QB rushing yards [−0.18, +0.13] inconclusive. RB, WR and TE improve on
every statistic.

## Price of independence (diagnostic only; never a decision input)

PURE_PLAYER_V1 − V4_MARKET_CLOSE (2024+2025, matched rows), ΔMAE: snap share +0.002, targets +0.013, receptions
+0.008, receiving yards +0.118, carries +0.050, rushing yards +0.093 (CI spans 0), passing attempts −0.013,
completions −0.034, passing yards +1.068 (CIs in RESULTS_TABLES.md). Points vs the closing implied team total:
+0.21. Small, consistent, and acceptable for an independent arm.

PURE_PLAYER_V1 − V4_MEF_AS_IS: within ±0.06 MAE on receiving statistics and carries (V4 slightly better, CIs
exclude 0 for targets, receptions, receiving yards, carries, snap share); PURE better on completions
(−0.055 [−0.094, −0.019]); passing attempts / yards and rushing yards inconclusive. V4_MEF_AS_IS is not a clean
market-free reference: its frame uses pregame injury-report and roster statuses whose nflverse vintage is not
point-in-time provable (no per-row timestamp from 2025), the schedule's realised starting QB, and its volume
training sample is gated on `implied_total.notna()`. Those teammate-status features are the most plausible source
of its remaining edge and are the obvious next PURE ablation once a timestamped status source exists.

## Market sample selection, measured

* **Training filter (`VolumeModel.fit`, volume.py:74)**: on nflverse history every team-game has a closing line,
  so the filter removes 0 of 6,724 team-games for 2025 (0 of 7,268 for 2026) — no historical accuracy effect. It is
  nevertheless a runtime dependency: blanking the lines of a random 30% of games shrinks V4's training sample to
  4,606 team-games and changes its predictions; removing them makes the loader refuse (mutation.json). PURE uses
  every team-game with a box score (5,758 for 2025: seasons 2014-2024).
* **Evaluation population (ticker inventory)**: Kalshi listed 3,394 (player, game) pairs in 2025 — 1,910 of 5,765
  receiving rows, 884 of 2,005 rushing rows, 342 of 544 starting-QB rows. POST-HOC (`posthoc_listed_subset_2025.json`,
  not preregistered): on the listed receiving rows PURE's gain over the baseline vanishes (targets +0.011
  [−0.014, +0.038], receptions +0.007 [−0.011, +0.025], receiving yards +0.19 [−0.04, +0.42]) while it is large on
  the unlisted rows (targets −0.214, receiving yards −0.61, CIs < 0). Carries, rushing, QB and snap-share gains
  hold on both. An evaluation restricted to market inventory would therefore have understated the receiving gain
  in the full population and reported a different model ranking — exactly the selection the audit flags.

## Runtime non-leakage

`mutation.json` (real data, target 2025, full pipeline rerun from files per mode): PURE forecasts (29,188 rows)
and team environment are **bit-identical** (sha256 d2c6e951…) under original / removed / randomised / 30%-blanked
schedule market columns; the kit gate's `mutation` reports 0 changed rows for each. Negative control (V4
VolumeModel): randomised -> `market_env=True` predictions change; partial blank -> `market_env=False` training
sample 6,724 -> 4,606 and predictions change; removed -> loader refuses. `tests/test_pure_player_v1.py` repeats
this on synthetic data in CI, plus a future-box-score test and a source scan.

## Kit gate

`validate`: PURE_PLAYER_V1 and PURE_EWM_BASELINE, 65,618 rows each, passed. `compare` (`gate_compare.json`,
2024-2026 pooled, 0 unmatched, 0 DNP): ΔMAE < 0 with CI < 0 on all 9 statistics; Brier lower on all 9.

## Sidecars

Full sidecars (65,618 rows per arm, 2024-2026) exceed the size budget; committed: a 2025 weeks 15-18 sample per arm
plus outcomes (`sidecars/SAMPLE_*`) and the sha256 of the full files (`sidecars/FULL_SIDECARS.sha256`), which the
study command regenerates.

## Limitations

* Conditional on playing (≥ 1 offensive snap or a box-score line); QB passing conditional on starting (schedule
  starter id). No participation model: PIT injury/inactive data are not provable from committed sources.
* Abstained inputs: injury reports, depth charts, weather, target-game QB identity, routes / play-by-play.
* Coverage p10-p90 runs above 0.80 for counts (0.88-0.93) because of discreteness at the interval ends.

## Shared PURE gate (sift-sports-intelligence/pure-contract/pure_gate.py 1.0.0, read-only)

* `validate` on the sidecars converted to `pure_forecast.v1` (`scripts/research/pure_player_v1_v1sidecar.py`,
  `model_frozen_hash git:0441dfc`, declared sports-only sources and per-feature lineage): both arms 65,618 rows,
  passed; one warning: `participation_probability=null` (not modelled) — `pure_gate_validate_v1.json`.
* `compare` (v1, B=1000, seed 20261010, `pure_gate_compare_v1.json`): ΔMAE, ΔBrier and ΔCRPS CIs < 0 on all 9
  statistics, 2024-2026 pooled.
* `rerun` (`pure_gate_rerun.json`, manifest `pure_gate_rerun_manifest.json`): market input = the schedule's
  market columns split into `market_lines.csv`; model = `scripts/research/pure_player_v1_rerun_cli.py` (PURE,
  target 2025); negative control = the same CLI with `--control` (V4 VolumeModel through the repository's
  market-reading loader). Verdict **PASS_RUNTIME_NONLEAKAGE**: model deterministic and byte-identical under
  deleted and randomised market input; control changed under randomisation and refused under deletion.
